# Guardrails ADR

> Open-source, local-first Agent Detection and Response platform (`grdr`) for developer endpoints, CI runners, AI coding harnesses, and MCP servers. Enforces Cedar policies and signed Essentials packs at tool boundaries over OS peer-authenticated IPC (`grdr-daemon`), records cryptographic decision receipts, and serves split Console and Operator planes over Connect/Protobuf RPCs (`grdr-server`).

## Core Capabilities

- Synchronous endpoint boundary enforcement across agent hooks (`grdr-hook`), stdio MCP proxying (`grdr mcp-proxy`), browser/WASM floor checks, and OS sensors (`grdr-sensor-*`)
- Split Console (`--bind`) and Operator (`--operator-bind`) Connect/Protobuf planes backed by `embedded` (SQLite), `ha` (PostgreSQL 18), and `distributed` (PostgreSQL 18 + NATS JetStream + object storage) profiles
- Multi-cell SaaS operations (`crates/grdr-saas`) providing region-pinned 4096-bucket shard routing, signed org migration bundles (`lake/` + `audit/`), idempotent usage metering, and zero-variance invoice reconciliation
- Standalone offline-searchable Docusaurus 3 + Pagefind documentation site (`website/`) and supply-chain verification (`security/supply-chain/licence-headers.toml`, `licences.toml`, `contracts/architecture.toml`)

## Quick Verification Commands

- Rust workspace lint & test: `cargo clippy --workspace --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace --locked`
- Web & docs workspaces: `pnpm --dir web run build` and `pnpm --dir website run build`
- Architecture, licence & docs gates: `node scripts/check-architecture.mjs`, `node scripts/licence-lint.mjs`, `node scripts/check-docs-gen.mjs --check`, `node scripts/check-docs.mjs`
